GetStart.title: Update Your Application with MirrorChyan
GetStart.description:
MirrorChyan is a third-party application distribution platform

that makes updating open-source applications easier.

Users pay for access, and the revenue is shared with developers.

Plus, MirrorChyan itself is open source.

Download.title: Download {rid} {os} {arch}
Download.disclaimer:
As a third-party distribution platform, MirrorChyan only charges for download acceleration services, which does not mean that {rid} requires a paid subscription.

You can still download and use it for free through {rid}'s official channels.

BatchPurchase.title: Buy CDKs in bulk
BatchPurchase.description: Purchase independent CDKs for project giveaways and community rewards.
BatchPurchase.invalidQuantity: Enter a whole number of at least 2.
BatchPurchase.independentKeys: Each CDK is independent and includes the full plan duration. Renewals are not available here.
BatchPurchase.amountTooLarge: The order total exceeds the supported amount. Reduce the quantity.
BatchPurchase.expiryNote: Validity starts when payment is confirmed, not when a recipient claims or first uses the CDK. Plan your giveaway accordingly.
BatchPurchase.plansUnavailable: Plans are temporarily unavailable. Refresh the page to try again.
BatchPurchase.paymentUnavailable: Bulk payment is not available for this plan. Choose another plan.
BatchPurchase.createFailed: Unable to create the order. Please try again later.
BatchPurchase.batchUnavailable: The payment service could not confirm this bulk purchase. Payment has not been opened. Please try again later or contact support.
BatchPurchase.attributionAfterPayment: After payment, you can optionally request revenue attribution to a project for these CDKs.
BatchPurchase.chargedInCny: Payment is charged in Chinese yuan (CNY)
BatchPurchase.closePaymentNote: Closing this dialog keeps the order query running and does not cancel a completed payment.
BatchPurchase.keepOrderReference: Keep this reference. Refresh this page or enter it in “Find CDK” to retrieve the entire batch.

BatchOrder.resultDescription: Retrieved {count} CDKs. Each can be sent to a different recipient.

BatchOrder.keysDescription: One CDK per line. Copy includes only the keys; TXT also includes the order, plan, and expiry for your records.

BatchAttribution.title: Revenue attribution (optional)
BatchAttribution.description: For project giveaways and community rewards. Before distributing the CDKs, you can submit check-in requests for a chosen project.
BatchAttribution.defaultOption: Leave unspecified; use each recipient’s first project check-in
BatchAttribution.specifyOption: Choose a project for this batch
BatchAttribution.manualOption: Enter a RID manually (for projects outside the directory)
BatchAttribution.ridPlaceholder: Enter a resource ID, not a URL
BatchAttribution.batchExpired: These CDKs have expired, so new check-in requests are unavailable. Existing revenue attribution remains unchanged.
BatchAttribution.manualHint: OS, architecture, and channel must match this RID’s release configuration. Select Unspecified for platform-independent resources. Checking a project does not use your CDKs.
BatchAttribution.catalogueFailed: Could not load projects. Retry or enter a RID manually.
BatchAttribution.noProjects: No matching projects in the directory. You can enter an unlisted RID manually.
BatchAttribution.chooseRelease: Choose the RID, channel, and platform to request
BatchAttribution.noReleaseOptions: No release configuration is listed. Confirm the RID and platform parameters with the project, then enter them manually.
BatchAttribution.overrideHint: This release uses {targetRid}, which differs from the directory project’s {projectRid}. Check-ins will target {targetRid}.
BatchAttribution.noRelease: No release is available for this RID, OS, architecture, or channel. Check the release configuration; this does not necessarily mean the RID is invalid.
BatchAttribution.quota: Daily quota reached; try again tomorrow
BatchAttribution.mismatch: This CDK plan does not support the project
BatchAttribution.invalidParams: Invalid parameters; check the RID and release configuration
BatchAttribution.requestFailed: Network or service error; request result could not be confirmed
BatchAttribution.checked: Found version {version}. This only confirms the release can be queried; no CDKs have been submitted yet.
BatchAttribution.firstCheckInRule: The first valid check-in determines attribution. Cards already attributed to another project will not be reassigned. Unspecified cards still follow their first project use.
BatchAttribution.effectNote: Submitting creates usage records and may affect revenue attribution for later renewals of the same CDK. It does not download files or extend the CDK’s validity.
BatchAttribution.confirm: I confirm submitting check-in requests for all {count} CDKs to {rid} and understand the first check-in rule.
BatchAttribution.keepOpen: Keep this page open while requests run. This page shows request progress and cannot confirm that revenue attribution has been saved.
BatchAttribution.resultNote: Requests have been processed. Successful requests trigger asynchronous check-ins; the first valid check-in still determines attribution. These results cover this session only. Refreshing does not remove or change an existing attribution.
